easy.scope: One center coordinate zero; signed 3-4 or 6-8 offsets; same distance and equation substitution stages

moderate.origin: six observed rated complete source banks
moderate.scope: Nonzero integer centers |h|,|k|<=5; nonzero integer offsets <=8; squared radius <=100; profile-specific radius-form constraints

hard.scope: Noninteger half-integer centers and offsets <=9/2; both differences and squares fractional; squared radius noninteger

exceptions.reason: Unrated and missing solution/correct designation; excluded from available inventory and normal generation; raw source preserved.

deduplication: Committed questions require different exact center and squared radius, even when supplied circumference points differ. Profile, seed, labels, identities and choice order never create inventory. Domain counts describe parameter tasks, not distinct circle equations.
